title: MF Create+Cobblemon
description: A collection of Cobblemon and Create mods with some config settings to hopefully provide a smooth experience across a broad range of hardware capabilities. This modpack was created for a private server but made public because it has been good fun.
body:
## MF Create + Cobblemon
#### Combining Create and Cobblemon with a bunch of bonus blocks for decoration.
This is a 1.21.1 modpack that I put together for a private server with a group of friends. It ended up being pretty fun so I figured I should publish it. Feel free to use this modpack in your own servers, no need to ask me for permission as I don't own any of the mods contained within, I merely glued all of them together with some config tweaks.
